info.description: The Sanidine Jacket Catalog Submission API facilitates the addition of detailed product information for Sanidine jackets into the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to submit essential details such as specifications, pricing, and availability, improving the catalog's accuracy and richness. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their inventory with detailed listings. By using this API, teams can ensure that customers have access to up-to-date information regarding the Sanidine jacket offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and store details for a Sanidine Jacket. Ensure that all necessary information is provided in the request body for successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to submit detailed information regarding the sanidine jacket operations. It is essential for ensuring that all required parameters are included in the request payload for correct processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.

CreateCatalogSanidineJacketDetailRequest.title: Sanidine Jacket Request Body

sanidine_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the sanidine jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the sanidine jacket.

quantity.description: The number of sanidine jackets being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority order or not.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the sanidine jacket.

CreateCatalogSanidineJacketDetailRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for creating a sanidine jacket order. It includes details such as the jacket ID, requester information, order quantity, priority status, and unit price.
